title: Scripture cue: faith working through love and James's dead faith make charity like soul to body
source_text: VII. Porro quod dedit illis occasionem vocandi charitatem fidei formam, illud est quod fides quae valet ad salutem, ab Apostolo describitur fides quae per charitatem operatur. Et quod Jacobus fidem sine charitatis operibus mortuam vocat. Etenim forma est illud per quod aliquid vivit & operatur, loca vero ista docent & innuunt fidem per charitatem vivere & agere; adeoque charitatem esse respectu fidei, quod est anima respectu corporis. Spiritus autem, seu anima est forma corporis viventis.
pass_a_gloss: Further, what gave them occasion for calling charity the form of faith is this: that the faith which avails unto salvation is described by the Apostle as faith which works through charity. And that James calls faith without the works of charity dead. For form is that through which something lives and operates, but those places teach and intimate that faith lives and acts through charity; and so charity is in respect of faith what the soul is in respect of the body. But the spirit, or soul, is the form of the living body.
pass_b_english: Their cue for calling charity faith's form is Scripture: Paul describes saving faith as faith that works through love, and James calls faith without charity's works dead.
Form is what something lives and acts by; so charity stands to faith as soul to body.

the soul in respect of the body

choices.why: Pauline warrant for Roman forma language.
